svg.aria-label: PYA: Protect Your Ass, a security audit for Claude Code. While the three bots sleep, a masked thief leaves a backdoored package at your app's door and sticks a note on the wall telling AI reviewers to give the repo 100 out of 100, and a key leaks out of the .env window. You type /pya, the bots wake up, sweep a scanner beam and stamp each attack: leaked, backdoor, nice try. The thief runs off, the report card shows 78 out of 100 capped at grade C by the critical finding, and an achievement pops up: ass protected.

g.text: caught: a live key leaking from .env
a backdoor, a leaked key and a prompt injection, caught
